decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding the spouse of John Brinsley Brooks. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S9) explicitly states he married 'Anna of Holstein-Gottorp' in 1575. Document 2 (D2S2, D2S7) explicitly states he is married to 'Lucinda Mary Fane de Salis', born in 1938. Since the prompt instructs to keep supported alternate referents rather than selecting one familiar winner and treats all audits/sources as fallible, both distinct answers supported by the text are retained as valid complementary answers.
